name: rekordbox
author: Jonathan Robichaud
description: Runs the XDJ-RX3 rekordbox player on the SC LIVE 4 (rblive4 by Malphite31). Start it from Settings > ABOUT / UPDATE > rekordbox, under Hardware Diagnostics, or from http://<deck-ip>:8093/. Engine stops while it runs and comes back when you hold SHIFT and BACK for two seconds or press Back to Engine on the web page. Setting up: make rekordbox-pack.tgz on a computer from your own extracted XDJ-RX3 v1.20 files with make-rekordbox-pack.py (only Python needed), then put it on a USB drive and press Set up, or upload it on the web page. No Pioneer files come with this mod. Built for EngineX OS 5.3.0.4.
